name: Contact Sheet
northStar: A sound library that reads like a well-kept tape archive: every clip labeled, measured, and one click from your timeline.

engine.source: Broadcast tape-box labels and spec sheets — the grammar of a field recordist's log, not its props.
engine.evidence: Users are post-production editors who search by metadata (mic, sample rate, location) before they listen.

tone._why: Quiet + dense: editors scan hundreds of rows. Refined: this is a paid professional tool.

benchmark.category: Sound-effects library for film and games
peers: Category leaders open with a cinematic hero video and a search box below the fold
keep: Search bar is the first thing on screen
change: Peers lead with a cinematic hero video; our users come to search, so the first screen is the result list

skeleton: Workspace. One-line header with search; filters as a single row of mono chips; 9 result rows visible at 1440x900; preview player docked at the bottom.
structure: (later) Single column list + slide-over detail panel.

type._relationship: Display only for the page title and clip names; all metadata in mono at step-n1.

color.from: The orange of a REC tally light — used only for 'playing' and the primary action, under 5% of the screen.

hero: The waveform of the selected clip, drawn in ink at full width; no photography.
icons: Lucide at 1.5px stroke, square caps, 16px; transport controls are glyphs (▶ ■) in mono.
controls: 2px radius, 1px hairline borders, pressed = inset 1px ink line; focus = 2px accent ring offset 2px.

motion.feel: 'Clack' — a cassette door closing: short, damped, no bounce.
motion.entrance: (later) Rows fade up 4px, 20ms stagger, first 9 only.
motion.action: (later) Play: waveform playhead sweeps; row tally dot lights.
motion.echo: (later) The same tally dot marks downloaded clips.

breakthrough: No hero at all — the result list starts 64px from the top.
memorable: Scrubbing a waveform with the arrow keys plays 200ms grains, like jogging a tape deck.
